admission.justification: Exact identity prevents a recipient from opening a different record revision or comparison than the developer selected, and focused tests guard both valid forms and contradictory identities.

applicability: Reference picks for invariants, families, review blocks, Code without invariant, tasks, file lines and change sets.
conditions: Identity and deduplication keep each kind’s applicable repository, object, revision, comparison, tree, side, path and range fields; snapshots are not aliased.
The server resolves record path and revision at the named memory tree, using the named leaf memory worktree while available, and rejects contradictory reference parts before filing.
The written form begins with knowledge_read for records/review blocks, read-only git diff for a lane/change set, or file read for tasks and file lines; the exact trees and range remain named.
exclusions: File-line checkout scope is not a frozen Git snapshot.
A review-block entry ID is not passed as a record ID.
This does not guarantee the recipient has opened the reference.
